description: Each line of a snapshot file with the transcript turn that wrote it (session, turn, and its share of that turn's priced cost), and the file's cost per authoring turn. Lines no transcript turn wrote (pasted, read, blank) have no origin. The turns themselves (get_transcript_turns) are read only by the entry's owner and admins. While build metrics are withheld from the caller (metrics_withheld) every cost is null. An entry's code (its snapshot tree and blame) is its owner's and admins' only, at every time, the deadline passed or not and its competition's winner's included: make.fun never publishes an entry's code. Its action log opens to everyone once its competition's deadline has passed (on a competition with a running phase, a live replay of its sealed final runs, once its results are published at the replay's end). Before then each opens only to the entry's owner (send your account's API key as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection) and to an admin's signed-in session: an admin's API key reads its action log but not its code until then. A closed part answers 403: before the deadline with the date its action log opens (none yet while a running phase's results are not out), after it, for a rival's code, with no date. Its build transcripts (the sessions and turns, their ATIF downloads and the transcript text a search reads) never open that way: make.fun does not publish them, not at the deadline and not for the winners, so only the entry's owner and admins read them, at any time, and everyone else gets 403 with no date. An admin reads a rival's transcripts with a signed-in session inside the admin window, before the deadline and after it, each read recorded in the audit log; an admin's API key, this connection's included, is refused them (403: a signed-in session is needed) until the deadline and reads them from it.
